Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate for the 
petitioner.

for the State. 
 Counter affidavit and rejoinder affidavit 
are taken on record. IA Nos.2 of 2025 and 
4 of 2025, stand disposed of accordingly.
 The delay in filing the counter affidavit 
is condoned. The counter affidavit is taken 
on record. IA No.5 of 2025, stands 
disposed of accordingly. 
 Heard on Interim Relief Application (IA) 
No.1 of 2024.
 It is argued that after filing of the 
counter affidavit, the petitioner came to 
know that de-limitation process has been 
done. The petitioner seeks amendment in 
the writ petition. 
 It is not objected to by the learned 
State counsel. 
 The Amendment Application (IA) No.3 
of 2025 is allowed.
 Let amended petition be filed within 
three days. 
 List on 16.05.2025.
